wizard.label: 1. Destination
wizard.behavior: Show the inspected host or cluster identity even when inferred. Never silently select a different context.

wizard.label: 2. Access and enrollment
wizard.behavior: Offer private or loopback HTTPS with an internal CA and one-time protected enrollment. Collect only a missing necessary input, explain trust enrollment and never generate a shared default password.

wizard.label: 3. Review and install
wizard.behavior: Show target, pinned release, resource changes, privileges, access, persistent volumes and approved outbound artifact destinations. Approval applies only to that immutable plan.

advancedBranches.explanation: Use an operator-owned compatible service only by choice. Verify trust, scoped access, persistence and shared-worker access before approval; do not discover and adopt unrelated resources.
Request only the missing namespace permissions, usable storage class or explicit existing ingress. Never replace cluster networking or silently choose a different cluster.
Show DNS, certificate trust and exposure implications. Public access requires separate explicit approval and authenticated bootstrap; automatic public ACME is not a default.
Resolve a signed local bundle or approved private mirror. Do not downgrade verification on a failed download. Offline support is not claimed before the disconnected release gate.
Validate aggregate connections, resource reservations, storage headroom and retention before scaling. Capacity profiles are hypotheses, not guaranteed sizing.
Accept the complete versioned configuration through the same resolver, schema validator, semantic preflight and approval engine as the wizard.

unattended.approvalValue: SHA-256 digest of the complete redacted plan with canonical resolved configuration, signed artifact digests and verified target identity. It is not a boolean --yes.
unattended.exportPolicy: Export reference names and deliberate choices, never resolved secret values. Use restrictive permissions and atomic replacement. Do not overwrite an existing configuration without a reviewed change.

secretReferencePolicy.details: Resolve references just in time into protected service inputs; ordinary argv, browser storage and source files never contain values. Existing references are not permission to rotate or delete the referenced secret.

semanticPreflight: Resolve every secret/profile/retention reference without leaking values; reject incompatible fallback graphs.
Sum all service replicas times their pool caps plus rollout overlap and reserved maintenance. Reject totals exceeding configured max or the actual server allowance.
Validate stable resource ownership IDs and data volumes; never use generated random replacement volumes on reapply.
Check approved target, TLS trust, ports, namespace permissions, database compatibility and private shared S3 access from every enabled worker role.
Apply least-privilege database roles and separate scoped S3 credentials derived from protected installer-owned roots. Application services never use database superuser credentials.
Verify signed release and platform image digests against an operator-trusted key; list artifact retrieval destinations before access.
Validate read/write/checksum/delete on an isolated synthetic readiness object and a fenced cross-service job round trip, not only HTTP 200.
Reject unsupported configuration or missing prerequisites with a resumable explanation. A schema-valid document is not a ready installation.

targetMatrix.platform: Ubuntu Server LTS with Podman Quadlet
targetMatrix.validationReason: M00 defines a candidate profile only. No Quadlet/Ansible application deployment or Linux restore test has run. Exact host-package lock belongs to the M01 lab before M02 deployment verification.

targetMatrix.platform: Upstream Kubernetes with an owned Helm chart
targetMatrix.validationReason: Candidate Kubernetes versions, not an exercised support range. Helm, K3s image/package locks, CSI/ingress compatibility, cross-node access and restore evidence remain required.

storageProfile.description: Flags freeze explicit upstream overrides but do not establish runtime isolation or production suitability of the mini profile. The coordinator's local image selection is not a storage conformance result.

readinessPolicy: No elapsed-time percentage or health-shaped substitute. Show completed stages, observed counters, pending checks and the failing dependency. Never advance stalled work to ready.

supportBoundary.description: The small profile has single-instance stateful services. Extra processes on a host isolate workloads but add no physical capacity; replicas on Kubernetes do not alone provide stateful HA.
